# Atlantic Training

> > Atlantic Training delivers comprehensive online safety and compliance training with an integrated EHS software platform (WAVE) to help organizations meet OSHA requirements and workplace safety standards.

Atlantic Training provides a complete ecosystem of safety training courses, learning management system integration, and EHS software solutions designed for workplace compliance. The platform serves organizations across industries with specialized training in hazard awareness, occupational health, and regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- OSHA Compliance
- WAVE EHS Software
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Workplace Safety
- Safety Training Courses
- Occupational Health
- HAZWOPER
- LOTO (Lock Out Tag Out)
- Bloodborne Pathogens (BBP)
- GHS (Globally Harmonized System)
- HAZCOM
- Employee Training
- Compliance Training
- Safety Courses Catalog
- Hazard Awareness

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [WAVE EHS Software with a Built-in Learning Management System](https://www.atlantictraining.com/wave-ehs-software): Integrated EHS software platform with built-in LMS for OSHA compliance and safety training management
- [Explore Safety Courses: Atlantic Training Catalog Access](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog): Complete catalog of safety, compliance, and HR training courses available for organizational needs
- [Online Safety Training Courses for the Jobsite or Office](https://www.atlantictraining.com/safety-training-for-the-workplace-and-jobsite): Comprehensive online safety training designed for workplace and jobsite environments
- [Add Training Videos to Your Safety Program and LMS](https://www.atlantictraining.com/downloadable-safety-videos-directly-to-your-learning-management-system): 500+ downloadable EHS training videos for seamless LMS integration and safety program enhancement

## Planning & Pricing

- [Create Your Plan](https://www.atlantictraining.com/create-your-plan): Customized training plan builder to meet specific OSHA compliance and organizational safety needs
- [Pricing Options](https://www.atlantictraining.com/pricing-options): Flexible pricing plans for WAVE EHS Software and comprehensive safety training course packages

## Specialized Safety Training Courses

- [Unraveling the Causes: Online Accident Investigation Training](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/accident-investigation-training): Accident investigation training course for incident response and root cause analysis
- [Be Prepared, Stay Safe: Active Shooter Response Courses](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/active-shooter-protocol-training): Active shooter response and emergency preparedness training for workplace security
- [Stay Informed: Asbestos Awareness for Modern Environments](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/asbestos-awareness-training): Asbestos awareness training for OSHA compliance and occupational health protection
- [Protect & Understand: Bloodborne Pathogens Safety Training](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/bloodborne-pathogens-safety-training): Bloodborne pathogens compliance training for occupational health and infection control
- [Safety First: Compressed Gas Safety Training Essentials](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/compressed-gas-safety-training): Compressed gas handling and safety training for hazardous materials management
- [Safe in Tight Spots: Confined Space Safety Training](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/confined-space-safety-training): Confined space operations safety training meeting OSHA standards and industry requirements
- [Comprehensive Electrical Safety Training for the Modern Worker](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/electrical-safety-training): Electrical safety training with OSHA and LOTO (Lock Out Tag Out) compliance
- [Be Ready: Essential Emergency Plans Training for Every Scenario](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/emergency-plans-training): Emergency preparedness and response planning training for organizational readiness

## Occupational Health & Ergonomics

- [Protect Your Spine: Online Back Safety Training](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/back-safety-training): Back safety and ergonomic training for workplace injury prevention and employee wellness
- [Maximum Safety: Ergonomic Safety Training for the Modern Workspace](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/ergonomic-safety-training): Ergonomic safety training for workplace comfort, health, and injury prevention
- [Clear Vision, Safe Practice: Comprehensive Eye Safety Training](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/eye-safety-training): Eye safety and personal protective equipment (PPE) training for occupational health
- [Breathe Easy: Understand Indoor Air with Quality Safety Training](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/indoor-air-quality-safety-training): Indoor air quality safety training for healthy workplace environments

## Transportation & Automotive Safety

- [Driving Safety Training for Workers and Fleet Drivers](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/driving-safety-training): Defensive driving and fleet safety training for employee transportation safety
- [Drive Safely: Online Automotive Safety Training](https://www.atlantictraining.com/catalog/automotive-safety-training): Specialized automotive safety training for workers in automotive environments
